changelog.title: FleetWise 1.0 Production & Standalone APK Release
changelog.highlights: Complete Taxi Business Intelligence, Fleet Management, 5-Year Profit Simulator, Gemini AI Free Tier diagnostics, and Standalone Android APK support.

features: Real-time Taxi Business Intelligence dashboard with MTD revenue, operating profit, and fuel expense analytics
Fleet Management CRUD with comprehensive fuel tags: EV, Petrol, Diesel, and CNG
Smart Trip Ledger with multi-platform ride aggregation (Ola, Uber, Rapido, and Private leases)
5-Year Multi-Vehicle Profit Simulator with compounding EMI, insurance, maintenance, and battery/engine degradation curves
Google Gemini Flash Free Tier AI Advisor for deep scenario diagnostics and fleet margin optimizations
mobile: Standalone Android APK wrapper powered by Capacitor 6
Offline-first architecture with local SQLite and IndexedDB caching for zero-connection operation
One-click local database backup export (JSON format) directly from device settings
Mobile-optimized adaptive bottom navigation and touch-friendly interface
improvements: High-performance MongoDB aggregation pipelines with sub-100ms response times
Strict Decimal128 currency representation eliminating floating-point financial discrepancies
Glassmorphism dark theme with high-contrast accessibility and smooth animations
In-app update checker and changelog viewer across both web and APK builds
fixes: Resolved PostCSS Tailwind @apply linting rules in IDE
Fixed Mongoose Document interface model inheritance typing
Secured JWT auth with Argon2 password hashing and refresh token rotation
